title.en: TRMNL 7.5-inch DIY Weather Dashboard
title.zh: TRMNL 7.5 英寸 DIY 天气仪表盘

excerpt.en: An ESPHome and Home Assistant weather dashboard for the Seeed Studio TRMNL 7.5-inch DIY Kit. It presents current conditions, daily forecasts, precipitation timing, air quality, allergen levels, and local sensor data, with 15-minute or button-triggered updates optimized for battery operation.
excerpt.zh: 一套面向 Seeed Studio TRMNL 7.5 英寸 DIY 套件的 ESPHome 与 Home Assistant 天气仪表盘。它显示当前天气、每日预报、降水时间、空气质量、过敏原水平和本地传感器数据，并支持每 15 分钟或按键触发更新，以适配电池供电。

title.en: Genius GM6000 BLE Mouse Revival
title.zh: Genius GM6000 蓝牙鼠标复活改造

excerpt.en: An open-source restoration of the classic Genius GM-6000 mechanical ball mouse. A custom PCB built around the Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 Sense preserves the original ball and encoder mechanics while adding Bluetooth LE and wired USB HID, automatic air-mouse mode, a rechargeable battery, and multi-stage power management.
excerpt.zh: 一项经典 Genius GM-6000 机械滚球鼠标的开源修复改造。项目使用基于 Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 Sense 的定制 PCB，保留原有滚球与编码器结构，并加入蓝牙 LE、有线 USB HID、自动空中鼠标模式、可充电电池和多级电源管理。

title.en: TrailNAV: Solar-Powered Off-Grid Exploration Device
title.zh: TrailNAV 太阳能离线探险导航设备

excerpt.en: A solar-powered offline navigation device built for outdoor exploration, waypoint tracking, and off-grid adventures. Built with the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6, a 2.7" Waveshare ePaper display, NEO-M8N GPS module, QMC5883L digital compass, and CN3791 MPPT solar charging module. Features sunlight-readable display, physical button interface, ultra-low-power operation, and a DIY PVC sunboard enclosure.
excerpt.zh: 一款太阳能供电的离线导航设备，专为户外探索、航点追踪和离网冒险设计。基于 Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6、Waveshare 2.7" 电子墨水屏、NEO-M8N GPS 模块、QMC5883L 数字罗盘和 CN3791 MPPT 太阳能充电模块。阳光直射可读的电子墨水屏、物理按键界面、超低功耗运行，PVC 阳光板 DIY 外壳。

title.en: AirBird (Indoor Air Quality Monitor): the Bird That Could Save Your Life
title.zh: AirBird 室内空气质量监测器：能救你命的鸟

excerpt.en: An IoT indoor air quality monitor housed inside a 3D-printed bird. When CO₂ levels spike or TVOC climbs into dangerous territory, a stepper motor silently rotates the bird upside down — turning invisible air chemistry into a visceral visual warning. Built with the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6 and SparkFun CCS811/BME280 combo sensor (eCO₂, TVOC, temp, humidity, pressure over I²C). Powered by Li-Ion battery with onboard charging. Open-source Arduino sketch with 3D-printable STL files, no cloud dependency.
excerpt.zh: 一款 IoT 室内空气质量监测器，外壳为 3D 打印小鸟。当 CO₂ 或 TVOC 超标时，步进电机静音旋转将鸟倒挂——把看不见的空气化学变化转化为直观的视觉警示。基于 Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6 和 SparkFun CCS811/BME280 组合传感器，通过 I²C 测量 eCO₂、TVOC、温湿度和气压。锂电池供电（XIAO 内置充电电路），开源的 Arduino 代码和 3D 打印文件，无需云端依赖。

title.en: The RoadBook — Rally-Inspired GPS Device for Riders & Adventurers
title.zh: eRoadBook 拉力赛风格 GPS 导航器

excerpt.en: A rally-inspired digital road book GPS device built with the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 (via EE05 ePaper Display Board) and a 4.26" monochrome ePaper display. Instead of turn-by-turn navigation, it works like rally co-drivers think — pre-planned waypoints count down distance as you ride, auto-advancing at 50m. Features real-time GPS tracking via L76K GNSS (GPS/BeiDou/GLONASS/QZSS), an emergency info button (displays blood type & contacts), and a Wi-Fi configuration page for trip management. 3D-printed enclosure, battery-powered.
excerpt.zh: 一款拉力赛风格的数字路书 GPS 导航设备，基于 Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3（EE05 电子纸显示板）和 4.26 寸黑白电子纸屏幕。不同于逐向导航，它模拟拉力赛领航员的思路——预先规划航点，骑行时倒计时显示距离，50 米自动切换到下一航点。集成 L76K GNSS（GPS/北斗/GLONASS/QZSS）实时定位，紧急按钮可显示血型和联系人，Wi-Fi 配置页面管理行程。3D 打印外壳，电池供电。

title.en: The Best Air Sensor is One You Can Make Yourself
title.zh: 最好的空气传感器，自己动手做

excerpt.en: A comprehensive tutorial on building the ultimate smart home air quality sensor using the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6 and Sensirion SEN66 sensor. Covers the full build from basic sensor readings to advanced features — ePaper/eInk display integration, ESPHome configuration (no programming required), Home Assistant dashboard with beautiful UI, and custom 3D-printed enclosure. Open-source design files on GitHub and 3D models on Printables/Makerworld.
excerpt.zh: 一份详细的智能家居空气质量传感器制作教程，使用 Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6 和 Sensirion SEN66 传感器。从基础传感器读数到高级功能全覆盖——电子纸墨水屏集成、ESPHome 配置（无需编程）、Home Assistant 精美仪表盘界面、以及定制 3D 打印外壳。设计文件和 3D 模型全部开源。

title.en: Build A Stealth MeshCore Repeater: Harbor Freight Hack!
title.zh: 隐身 MeshCore 中继器：利用 Harbor Freight 太阳能灯改造

excerpt.en: A portable stealth MeshCore mesh network repeater built using the Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 with Wio SX1262 LoRa kit, hidden inside a Harbor Freight solar motion sensor light. Runs MeshCore firmware for off-grid mesh communication. A creative ham radio / IoT project combining off-the-shelf hardware with open-source mesh networking firmware for portable field deployment.
excerpt.zh: 一款便携隐身 MeshCore 网状网络中继器，使用 Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 加 Wio SX1262 LoRa 套件，藏在 Harbor Freight 太阳能运动感应灯内。运行 MeshCore 固件实现离网网状网络通信。一个将现成产品与开源 Mesh 组网固件结合的创意业余无线电/IoT 项目，适合野外部署。

title.en: MINTIA Micropython Console
title.zh: MINTIA 薄荷糖盒 MicroPython 游戏机

excerpt.en: A DIY handheld game console built into a MINTIA breath mint candy box using the Seeed Studio XIAO RP2350 and a 1.54" 240×240 ST7789 IPS display. Runs MicroPython with AI-generated code for Tetris and other games. Features 8 tactile buttons (D-pad + A/B + Start/Select), LiPo battery power with onboard charging, and a 3D-printed back panel. Open-source sample code on GitHub.
excerpt.zh: 一款 DIY 手持游戏机，利用 MINTIA 薄荷糖盒和 Seeed Studio XIAO RP2350 及 1.54 寸 240×240 ST7789 IPS 显示屏打造。运行 MicroPython，代码由 AI 辅助生成（如俄罗斯方块游戏）。配备 8 个按键（方向键 + A/B + Start/Select）、锂电池供电（内置充电电路）和 3D 打印后盖。开源示例代码托管在 GitHub。

title.en: XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense Retro Camera
title.zh: XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense 复古相机

excerpt.en: A compact retro-styled digital camera built on the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense. Captures 1280×720 photos and MJPEG/PCM audio video with a 2.0" TFT live viewfinder. Features encoder-driven menu, on-device gallery with thumbnail previews, self-timer, timelapse, slideshow, and a tabbed WiFi file server with QR code pairing. Built on FreeRTOS multi-core architecture.
excerpt.zh: 基于 Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense 的紧凑型复古风格数码相机。可拍摄 1280×720 照片和 MJPEG/PCM 音视频，配备 2.0" TFT 实时取景器。支持编码器菜单系统、设备内图库缩略图预览、自拍定时、延时摄影、幻灯片播放，以及带二维码配对的 WiFi 文件管理。采用 FreeRTOS 多核架构。

title.en: Giant XIAO — 15x Scale Fully Functional XIAO ESP32-C3 Replica
title.zh: 巨型 XIAO — 15 倍大全功能 XIAO ESP32-C3 复制品

excerpt.en: A fully functional 15× scale replica of the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3, built with 3D-printed PLA and copper tape wiring. Every pin is wired through to a real XIAO hidden inside the giant USB-C port, making the giant board electrically functional. Features swappable chip housing and magnetic interior tray. Created by the TinyGo team and presented at GopherCon EU 2026.
excerpt.zh: 3D 打印的全功能 15 倍大 XIAO ESP32-C3 复制品。每个引脚通过铜箔胶带连接到藏在巨型 USB-C 接口内的真实 XIAO，使巨型开发板具备完整电气功能。配备可更换芯片外壳和磁吸内部收纳托盘。由 TinyGo 团队制作，在 GopherCon EU 2026 展示。

title.en: ESP Dash — Local ESP32 Sensor Data Visualization
title.zh: ESP Dash — 本地 ESP32 传感器数据可视化

excerpt.en: A tutorial demonstrating ESP Dash for locally visualizing ESP32 sensor data via web dashboard. Built with the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C5 and XIAO Logger HAT featuring temperature, humidity, light sensor, RTC, and battery voltage monitoring. Uses PlatformIO and ESPAsyncWebServer to create a real-time dashboard running entirely on the local network without cloud dependency.
excerpt.zh: 一个演示 ESP Dash 的教程，通过网页仪表盘在本地可视化 ESP32 传感器数据。使用 Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C5 和 XIAO Logger HAT（温度、湿度、光线传感器，带 RTC 和电池电压监测）。基于 PlatformIO 和 ESPAsyncWebServer 构建实时仪表盘，完全在本地网络运行，无需云端依赖。

title.en: Tripwire — Cyberpunk ESP32 BLE & WiFi Radar Scanner
title.zh: Tripwire — 赛博朋克 ESP32 BLE 与 WiFi 雷达扫描器

excerpt.en: A wireless reconnaissance platform built around the XIAO ESP32-C5 that detects, visualizes, and logs Bluetooth and WiFi activity in real time. Features a round TFT radar display, SD card logging, geiger-style proximity audio, and rechargeable battery. Tracks devices via RSSI with a cyberpunk-inspired radar UI for portable situational awareness.
excerpt.zh: 基于 XIAO ESP32-C5 的无线侦察平台，可实时检测、可视化和记录附近的蓝牙与 WiFi 活动。配备圆形 TFT 雷达显示屏、SD 卡日志记录、盖革计数器式距离音频提示和可充电电池。通过 RSSI 追踪设备，赛博朋克风格雷达 UI，便携式态势感知工具。

title.en: Sneaky Gestures V2 — Bluetooth Gestural MIDI Glove
title.zh: Sneaky Gestures V2 — 蓝牙手势 MIDI 手套

excerpt.en: A wearable BLE-MIDI gestural instrument glove built on the Seeed XIAO nRF52840 Sense. Features 12 conductive finger pads for scale-quantized note playing, flex sensor for glissando pitch bend, thumb FSR for aftertouch, and dual-axis accelerometer for continuous MIDI CC control. Includes 20 selectable scales, tap tempo, 63 presets, RGBW LED display, and serial patch backup. Transmits as standard BLE-MIDI to any DAW or hardware synth.
excerpt.zh: 一款基于 Seeed XIAO nRF52840 Sense 的可穿戴 BLE-MIDI 手势乐器手套。配备了 12 个导电手指触垫用于音阶量化演奏、弯音柔性传感器、拇指 FSR 触后感应、双轴加速度计 MIDI CC 控制。支持 20 种音阶、打拍定速、63 个预置位、RGBW LED 显示和串口备份恢复。作为标准 BLE-MIDI 设备连接任何 DAW 或硬件合成器。

title.en: Mood Paint
title.zh: Mood Paint 情绪绘画

excerpt.en: A bio-responsive painting system that turns physiological signals into real-time generative visuals. A wearable glove or bracelet uses XIAO ESP32-C3 with heart-rate and galvanic-skin-response sensors, translating the captured data into changing colors, movement, density, and rhythm.
excerpt.zh: 一套把生理信号转化为实时生成式视觉画面的生物响应绘画系统。可穿戴手套或手环使用 XIAO ESP32-C3、心率传感器和皮肤电反应传感器采集数据，再将其转化为不断变化的颜色、运动、密度与节奏。

title.en: E61 Gauge — Analog Temperature Gauge for E61 Espresso Machines
title.zh: E61 模拟温度表 — 适用于 E61 咖啡机

excerpt.en: An analog temperature gauge for E61 espresso machines. Custom PCB drives a VID6606 stepper motor gauge needle, reading temperature from an NTC thermistor. Connects via BLE to a web app for calibration and real-time monitoring. Features a non-linear dial scale (0–150°C) with expanded green zone at 92–97°C, SLM 3D-printed metal enclosure, and open-source KiCad/Arduino design.
excerpt.zh: 一款 E61 咖啡机模拟温度表。定制 PCB 驱动 VID6606 步进电机表针，NTC 热敏电阻测温。通过 BLE 蓝牙连接网页应用进行校准和实时监测。非线性表盘刻度（0–150°C），92–97°C 绿色区间放大便于精确观察。SLM 3D 打印金属外壳，KiCad 源文件和 Arduino 固件全部开源。

title.en: Bit:busy — LED Bar That Indicates Your Work Status
title.zh: Bit:busy LED 工作状态指示条

excerpt.en: An LED status bar that indicates whether you are busy or free, so colleagues won't distract you. Built with the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 and WS2812B 8x32 LED Matrix. Features a local web server at bitbusy.local with three modes: Manual (BUSY/FREE toggle), Pomodoro Timer (25-min focus, 5-min break), and Custom message. Runs entirely on local Wi-Fi with no cloud dependency. Open-source firmware on GitHub.
excerpt.zh: 一款 LED 工作状态指示条，让同事知道你是否忙碌。基于 Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 和 WS2812B 8x32 LED Matrix。本地 Web 服务器 (bitbusy.local) 提供三种模式：手动开关（BUSY/FREE）、番茄钟（25分钟专注/5分钟休息）和自定义消息。完全在本地 Wi-Fi 运行，无需云端依赖。开源固件。

title.en: AI Meeting Recorder using XIAO ESP32 S3 Sense
title.zh: AI 会议记录器 — 基于 XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense

excerpt.en: A pocket-sized AI meeting recorder built with the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense. Records conversations and automatically generates detailed summaries using Elevenlabs and OpenAI APIs. Leverages the dual-core processor to chunk audio into 15-second segments for seamless real-time transcription without hitting memory limits. Inspired by the Neo Sapiens pitch on Shark Tank India.
excerpt.zh: 一款口袋大小的 AI 会议记录器，基于 Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense。录制对话内容，通过 Elevenlabs 和 OpenAI API 自动生成详细摘要。利用双核处理器将音频分块为 15 秒片段，实现无缝实时转录。灵感来自 Shark Tank India 的 Neo Sapiens 演示。

title.en: Getting Started with XIAO MG24 / XIAO MG24 Sense (Arduino)
title.zh: XIAO MG24 / XIAO MG24 Sense Arduino 入门指南

excerpt.en: A comprehensive Japanese tutorial blog post on using the Seeed Studio XIAO MG24 and XIAO MG24 Sense in the Arduino environment. Covers basic GPIO, I2C (Wire/Wire1 troubleshooting), WS2812 LED control, DAC output, 6-axis IMU, PDM microphone, and BLE UART communication with practical troubleshooting advice.
excerpt.zh: 一篇详细的日文博客教程，介绍如何在 Arduino 环境中使用 Seeed Studio XIAO MG24 和 XIAO MG24 Sense。涵盖 GPIO 基础、I2C（Wire/Wire1 问题排查）、WS2812 LED 控制、DAC 输出、6 轴 IMU、PDM 麦克风和 BLE UART 通信，附有实用的故障排除建议。

title.en: Make your own satellite
title.zh: 自制 CanSat 微型卫星

excerpt.en: A fully functional CanSat (miniature satellite designed to fit inside a soft drink can) built with the XIAO ESP32-C6. Measures real-time atmospheric data (temperature, pressure, humidity, orientation) and transmits telemetry via LoRa (RYLR998) to a ground station. Features a parachute deployment system for controlled landing. Perfect for students in robotics, electronics, and aerospace engineering.
excerpt.zh: 一款全功能 CanSat（装在易拉罐里的微型卫星），基于 XIAO ESP32-C6 构建。实时测量大气数据（温度、气压、湿度、姿态），通过 LoRa (RYLR998) 遥测传输到地面站。配备降落伞部署系统实现可控着陆。适合机器人、电子和航空航天工程学生。

title.en: Build Battery Powered Smart Home Devices (Xiao nRF52840 + Matter)
title.zh: 打造电池供电智能家居设备（XIAO nRF52840 + Matter 协议）

excerpt.en: A comprehensive tutorial on building ultra-low-power Matter smart home devices using the Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 and nRF Connect SDK. Covers SDK setup, power optimization, bootloader (MCUBoot), OTA updates, CHIP factory data, Device Tree, ZAP + Matter Data Model, and full code walkthrough with an SHT41 sensor. Open-source code on GitHub.
excerpt.zh: 一份全面的教程，使用 Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 和 nRF Connect SDK 构建超低功耗 Matter 智能家居设备。涵盖 SDK 环境搭建、功耗优化、引导加载程序 (MCUBoot)、OTA 更新、CHIP 工厂数据、设备树、ZAP + Matter 数据模型配置，以及 SHT41 传感器的完整代码讲解。开源代码托管在 GitHub。

title.en: This Tiny Device Detects WiFi & Bluetooth Attacks in Real Time
title.zh: 微型 WiFi 与蓝牙攻击实时检测器

excerpt.en: A compact XIAO-based Bluetooth & WiFi attack detector for ethical hacking enthusiasts. Built around the XIAO ESP32-C5, this device detects and displays network information using radio frequency detection. Features a custom software interface, mobile app integration, 6×10 RGB Matrix display, and open-source GitHub code with 3D-printable case.
excerpt.zh: 一款基于 XIAO 的紧凑型蓝牙与 WiFi 攻击检测器，适合道德黑客爱好者。采用 XIAO ESP32-C5 为核心，通过射频检测发现并显示网络信息。配备自定义软件界面、手机应用、6×10 RGB Matrix 显示屏，开源 GitHub 代码和 3D 打印外壳。

title.en: $40 Wireless Vibe Coding Voice Keyboard
title.zh: 40美元无线语音编程键盘

excerpt.en: A step-by-step guide to building a wireless vibe coding voice keyboard for under $40 using Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 Sense. Features Bluetooth voice-to-text input for hands-free coding, with a Grove OLED display for feedback and Grove Mech Keycap. Designed for accessibility and creative coding workflows.
excerpt.zh: 不到 40 美元的无线语音编程键盘制作教程，基于 Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840 Sense。支持蓝牙语音转文字输入，配合 Grove OLED 显示和机械键帽，适合无障碍编程和创意工作流。

title.en: ET MeetingRoom ePaper Sign — SharePoint Room Reservation Display
title.zh: ET 会议室电子墨水屏标识牌 — SharePoint 会议室预订显示

excerpt.en: An integrated ePaper meeting room sign built around the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 that bridges a reTerminal E1002 full-color ePaper display with a SharePoint Server 2019 room-booking calendar. The XIAO acts as a lightweight REST API wrapper, caching SharePoint OData results and serving clean JSON to a SenseCraft HMI-powered display. Designed for on-premises deployment with no cloud dependency and military-grade security.
excerpt.zh: 基于 Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 的集成式会议室电子墨水屏标识牌，连接 reTerminal E1002 彩色电子纸显示屏与 SharePoint Server 2019 会议室预订日历。XIAO 作为轻量 REST API 包装器，缓存 SharePoint OData 结果并输出干净 JSON 给 SenseCraft HMI 界面。纯本地部署，无云端依赖，达到军事级安全标准。

title.en: DIY JOY AI Desktop Companion Robot
title.zh: DIY JOY AI 桌面陪伴机器人

excerpt.en: An AI desktop companion robot built with the Seeed Studio ReSpeaker XVF3800 4-Mic Array with XIAO ESP32S3 for voice detection and AI processing. Features an OLED display for facial expressions, speaker with amplifier for voice responses, and a custom 3D-printed body. Uses Xiaozhi open-source voice AI firmware for wake word detection and natural conversation.
excerpt.zh: 基于 Seeed Studio ReSpeaker XVF3800 4-Mic Array（带 XIAO ESP32S3）的 AI 桌面陪伴机器人。配有 OLED 表情显示屏、语音功放扬声器，以及定制 3D 打印外壳。采用 Xiaozhi 开源语音 AI 固件实现唤醒词检测和自然对话交互。

title.en: Gratitude Loom
title.zh: Gratitude Loom 感恩织机

excerpt.en: A ritual weaving instrument that combines hand weaving, sensing, and cloud intelligence. Hall effect sensors read the rhythm and consistency of each weaving action, then the system selects or generates the next pattern while the weaver remains free to change, pause, or end the process.
excerpt.zh: 一台融合手工编织、传感检测与云端智能的仪式化织机。霍尔传感器读取每次编织动作的节奏与一致性，系统据此选择或生成下一种纹样，同时织作者可以随时更改纹样、暂停或结束过程。

title.en: Corporate Slave Digital Phone DP192 — Reviving a 1996 Phone with ESP32
title.zh: 社畜数字电话 DP192 — 用 ESP32 复活 1996 年手机

excerpt.en: A creative revival of a 1996 Good Design Award-winning digital mobile phone (Nippondenso DP192) using Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3. The phone checks a designated email inbox every 5 minutes and alerts via OLED display and buzzer when matching keywords are found. Part of the 'Corporate Slave Warning Light' series for system fault monitoring, with open source Arduino code available on GitHub.
excerpt.zh: 用 Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 复活 1996 年 Good Design Award 获奖数字手机 DP192。每 5 分钟检查指定邮箱，收到含关键字的邮件时通过 OLED 显示屏和蜂鸣器发出警报。属于"社畜警示灯"系列——用于系统故障监控的开源 Arduino 项目。

title.en: Modular Wearable Platform — Stackable Electronics with XIAO nRF52840
title.zh: 模块化可穿戴平台 — 基于 XIAO nRF52840 的堆叠式电子系统

excerpt.en: A modular wearable development platform built around the Seeed Studio XIAO nRF52840, where each function lives on its own stackable module. Features heart rate monitoring via MAX30101, step counting via MPU6050 IMU, OLED display output, and Bluetooth BLE data transmission. An early prototype demonstrating a flexible approach to wearable system design.
